Submission Instructions

  1. Write NORMALIZATION.md: a short statement of your normalization policy and a table of rules (each with an id, a category, the original and normalized form, and the TEI element used).
  2. Apply your rules by hand to your reconciled transcription using <choice> with <orig>/<reg> or <abbr>/<expan>; paste or attach the result.
  3. Have an AI model apply the same rules and, in NORMALIZATION.md, write a short note (no minimum length) comparing its result with yours.
